steps.instruction:
交付closure-trace.csv、環境圖與兩種共享狀態反例。
在交接件中加入「JavaScript 閉包：詞法環境與迴圈綁定 — 建立契約與基準」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：var輸出[3,3,3]合計9；let為[0,1,2]合計3；直接在迴圈內執行不構成相同測試。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：畫出回呼到環境紀錄的箭頭，迴圈結束才執行全部回呼以隔離排程因素。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver closure-trace.csv, environment diagrams and both shared-state counterexamples.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for JavaScript closures: lexical environments and loop bindings — Establish the contract and baseline: var yields[3,3,3], sum 9; let yields[0,1,2], sum 3; immediate calls inside the loop are a different test.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Draw callback-to-environment edges and run all callbacks only after the loop, isolating scheduling. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
